direction: Daily base-volume Money Flow Index momentum with fixed45exit,unlevered spot long/cash.
hypothesis: Weight typical-price directional days by raw base-volume money flow. Test whether positive flow dominance with a lower exit boundary survives costs and varied regimes. This is our momentum hypothesis;source documentation cautions against assuming that MFI centerline bias is a reliable trend signal.

sources.scope: Primary definition TP*volume,positive/negative TP-direction flows and exclusion of unchangedTP. Our momentum rules and neutral50zero-flow convention are independent choices,not profitability endorsement.

Primary implementation confirms Nflows with an earlierTP and unchanged-price exclusion. We do not use its total-flow<1 zero guard:exact total-flow0 is independently fixed to50. No equivalence claim,library install or copied C source.
Official spot filter definitions;historical filters unavailable.

rule.signal: Aggregate UTC daily high/low,last close and base volume over1440closed minutes. TP=(H+L+C)/3. Raw flow=TP*base_volume;assign to positive ifTP rises,negative ifTP falls,zero to both whenTP ties. Sum Nflows overj-N+1..j,using earlierTP atj-N. MFI=100*positive/(positive+negative);if total exactly0,set50. For exact thresholds use TP3=H+L+C,flow3=TP3*volume,which cancels the common3. Local Decimal60 flow arithmetic and cross-multiplied thresholds;accounting kernel remainsDecimal28. No seed/fold reset.
rule.entry: When flat,enter iff MFI>E;strict boundary,no prior-cross requirement,including first OOS decision. Zero total flow yields neutral50.
rule.exit: When long,exit iff MFI<45;equality45keeps long. Zero total flow50keeps long. No short,hold cap or same-decision re-entry;costed terminal liquidation.
rule.execution: Signal becomes available at the signal candle close; if target changes, simulate an order at the next UTC day 00:01 one-minute open (60-second delay). Rejected orders are not backfilled; the same desired state may be tried on a later new daily decision. At the frozen OOS terminal timestamp, liquidate any open lot with costs.
rule.account: Independent 2,000 USDT single-asset cash account for every asset×parameter combination; all initial capital assigned to the specified asset sleeve, no leverage, borrowing, shorting, transfer or cash interest.

time_boundaries.walk_forward: 12 consecutive, non-overlapping 30-day evaluation windows; account remains continuous across windows; no fitting, parameter selection or fold reset.
time_boundaries.history_note: The 2025–2026 OOS window has been reused extensively in this repository and is not an untouched final holdout.

validation.neighborhood: Same asset, adjacent lookback index and adjacent hurdle index in the frozen 3×3 grid; 3×3 neighborhood including center.
validation.multiple_testing: No DSR/PBO claim: repeated reused-OOS history and many prior strategy trials create material selection bias.
validation.purging: No fitted model or future-return labels;label purge inapplicable. Ncomplete directional flows requireN+1completed daily prices;first valid indexN. No future padding,seed,OOS/fold reset or parameter selection.365day context and3day initial gap precede12continuous folds.
validation.continuous_drawdown: Initial capital plus all OOS minute-close and immediate post-fill marks; no fold reset or intraminute extrema.

costs.impact: 0.5 × sample stdev of previous 20 complete UTC daily log returns × sqrt(order quote budget / previous 20 complete daily quote ADV)
costs.filters_source: Unchanged 2026-10-14 frozen public exchangeInfo proxy, checked against the current public response in filter_check.json. Reuse the original hash so retrieval timestamps cannot manufacture novelty. Historical L2 and historical filters are unavailable.

data.format: Archived Binance spot 1m OHLCV; daily closes and quote ADV are aggregated from fully closed UTC days.

prior_results.last_batch: 18 CCI candidates rejected;two all-cost positive cells did not meet fold breadth or full robustness.
prior_results.distinction: MFI weights typical-price direction by actual daily base volume,not a price-only mean-deviation score or extrema age.

account_scope: Offline research only. Read existing paper10 and delayed SMA-shadow accounts without reset, replacement, new paper observations or real orders.
